title: LoRa TDMA telemetry (proposed contract)

event_id.description: Node-origin opaque logical Event ID (C05), stable across RF retry, MQTT QoS1 replay and Node/Gateway reboot. Uniqueness and dedup key scoped by (gateway_id, node_id, event_id); exact binary encoding/persistence pending G2.

gateway_epoch.description: Gateway reception tracking: boot epoch, not origin identity of a sensor event; can differ on re-reception/reboot. Never derive business event_id from it.

event_seq.description: Gateway reception tracking sequence scoped to gateway_epoch, not Node Event ID or business dedup key.

observed_at.description: Event occurrence time (UTC Z) only when a defensible time source exists. Null when unknown; never silently backfill with ingest time.

radio_rx_monotonic_us.description: Gateway-local monotonic microseconds; meaningful only within gateway_epoch. Do not compare across boots.

buffered.description: Offline/replay path; keep Node event_id unchanged, even when Gateway reconnects/reboots. May preserve original gateway reception metadata.

node_id.description: Node ID in range 1..254, scoped to gateway_id (C06); authenticated source must match the provisioned mapping.

slot_id.description: Slot ID in current approved Gateway schedule; no fixed 15-slot production limit. Priority Alert can use a priority opportunity instead of a periodic DATA Slot.

data.description: Raw integer RF fields only; scale/unit are versioned sensor configuration, not derived by Gateway.

description: DRAFT contract aligned with G0 C05/C06: Node-origin event_id and Gateway reception metadata are different identities. No RF byte layout, crypto or event-ID format approved; semantic auth/dedup and implementation NOT_VERIFIED.
